promises.label: FY26 revenue growth guidance 2-3% cc
promises.quote: The new guidance is growth between 2% and 3% in constant currency terms for the full year.
promises.speaker: Salil Parekh

promises.label: FY26 operating margin 20-22%
promises.quote: our operating margin guidance remains the same as in the past quarter at 20% to 22% for the full year.
promises.speaker: Salil Parekh

promises.label: Fresher hiring ~20,000 in FY26
promises.quote: we had said 20,000 is what we expect. We have hired in the first half, 12,000-plus freshers already. So we are well on our track to hire close to 20,000 this year.
promises.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

promises.label: Buyback ₹18,000 crore at ₹1,800, Q3 completion
promises.quote: The amount is INR 18,000 crores at INR 1,800 which we will be executing... Buyback is expected to be completed in Q3, subject to shareholder approval.
promises.speaker: Jayesh Sanghrajka

promises.label: Versent JV close in coming months
promises.quote: They are going through regulatory approvals... We anticipate it would come sometime in the coming months.
promises.speaker: Salil Parekh

promises.label: Capital return policy 85% FCF over 5 years
promises.quote: we have a policy where we return 85% of our free cash flow over a 5-year period.
promises.speaker: Salil Parekh

reported.label: Q2 revenue growth 2.2% qoq, 2.9% yoy cc
reported.quote: Our revenues for the quarter grew 2.2% sequentially and 2.9% year-on-year in constant currency terms.

reported.label: Q2 large deals $3.1 bn, 67% net new
reported.quote: Our large deals were at $3.1 bn, out of which 67% was net new work.

reported.label: Mega deal $1.6 bn with UK NHS
reported.quote: we announced a mega deal worth $1.6 bn after the close of the quarter, but before our results announcement.

reported.label: Net headcount addition 8,000 in Q2
reported.quote: We have added 8,000 employees during the quarter.

reported.label: H1 fresher hiring over 12,000
reported.quote: We continue to invest in talent and have hired over 12,000 freshers in the last 6 months.
